edges.reason: Constructor stores msg.sender into creatorAddress, granting the deployer creator rights.
onlyCREATOR reads creatorAddress to compare against the untrusted msg.sender.
onlySERAPHIM uses msg.sender as the key into the seraphims whitelist mapping.
onlyCREATOR guards addSERAPHIM, restricting seraphim addition to the creator.
onlyCREATOR guards removeSERAPHIM.
onlyCREATOR guards updateMaintenanceMode.
onlyCREATOR guards removeCreator in the interface.
onlySERAPHIM guards setAngel in the interface.
onlySERAPHIM guards addToAngelExperienceLevel.
onlySERAPHIM guards setAngelLastBattleTime.
onlySERAPHIM guards setAngelLastVsBattleTime.
onlySERAPHIM guards setLastBattleResult.
onlySERAPHIM guards transferAngel.
onlySERAPHIM guards setBestAngel.
addSERAPHIM writes true into the seraphims mapping for the new address.
addSERAPHIM performs an unchecked totalSeraphims += 1 on a uint16 counter.
The raw increment writes the totalSeraphims state variable, risking overflow.
removeSERAPHIM writes false into the seraphims mapping.
removeSERAPHIM performs an unchecked totalSeraphims -= 1 on a uint16 counter.
The raw decrement writes the totalSeraphims state variable, risking underflow.
updateMaintenanceMode writes the caller-supplied flag into isMaintenanceMode.
Parameter _newSeraphim is passed into addSERAPHIM.
Parameter _newSeraphim is used as the mapping key written by addSERAPHIM.
Parameter _oldSeraphim is passed into removeSERAPHIM.
Parameter _oldSeraphim is used as the mapping key written by removeSERAPHIM.
Parameter _isMaintaining is passed into updateMaintenanceMode.
Parameter _isMaintaining is stored into the isMaintenanceMode state variable.
safeAdd performs the raw addition x + y before asserting the result.
safeSubtract performs the raw subtraction guarded only by an assert.
safeMult performs the raw multiplication before the overflow assert.
getRandomNumber computes the modulo arithmetic result from the seed.
getRandomNumber derives its seed from block.blockhash, a manipulable pseudo-random source.
Parameter x is passed into safeAdd.
Parameter y is passed into safeAdd.

Parameter y feeds the unchecked addition inside safeAdd.

Parameter y is passed into safeSubtract.

Parameter y feeds the raw subtraction inside safeSubtract.
Parameter x is passed into safeMult.
Parameter y is passed into safeMult.
Parameter x feeds the raw multiplication inside safeMult.
Parameter y feeds the raw multiplication inside safeMult.
safeAdd computes and returns the local variable z.
safeSubtract computes and returns the local variable z.
safeMult computes and returns the local variable z.

Parameter maxRandom is passed into getRandomNumber.
Parameter min is passed into getRandomNumber.
Parameter privateAddress is passed into getRandomNumber.
Parameter maxRandom participates in the modulo range arithmetic.
Parameter min participates in the modulo range arithmetic.

setBestAngel writes the caller-supplied threshold into bestAngel.
Parameter _bestAngel is passed into setBestAngel.
Parameter _bestAngel is stored into the bestAngel state variable.
getBestAngel reads the bestAngel state variable.
getBattleCooldown reads the hardcoded angelCardDataContract address.
getBattleCooldown instantiates the local interface variable from the stored address.
getBattleCooldown performs an external call to an untrusted contract without reentrancy protection.
The local interface instance is used to perform the external getAngel call.
Parameter angelID is passed into getBattleCooldown.
Parameter angelID is forwarded as the argument of the external getAngel call.
The external call returns angel experience into the local variable experience.
bestAngel is read by getBattleCooldown for cooldown tier comparisons.
The returned experience value drives the cooldown tier branching.
getNextBattleTime reads the hardcoded angelCardDataContract address.
getNextBattleTime instantiates the local interface variable from the stored address.
The local interface instance is used for the external getAngel call in getNextBattleTime.
The external call returns the angel last battle time into the local variable.
getNextBattleTime declares and populates the angellastBattleTime local from external data.
getNextBattleTime performs an unchecked addition of last battle time and cooldown.
The externally supplied last battle time feeds the unchecked addition.
Parameter angelId is passed into getNextBattleTime.
Parameter angelId is forwarded as the argument of the external getAngel call.
getNextBattleTime internally calls getBattleCooldown, chaining a second external call.
The external angelCardData contract can call back into getBattleCooldown during execution.
The external angelCardData contract can re-enter getNextBattleTime before state finalization.
